verses.text: Ha in tik, niwan wal ix aj wab'an sya'il yuj yowal sk'ol Dios.
Ix in spechb'at t'a skal k'ik' k'inal b'aj junelnhej k'ik'olinak. Ix in yak' b'ey t'a yoltak b'e b'aj malaj sakil k'inal.
Masanil k'u ichanhej tik in smak'an yet' yowal sk'o'ol.
Ix yak' ichamax in niwanil, chok'xonhej ix yutejkanb'at in b'akil.
Ix in smakchej yet' ya'elal yet' kusk'olal.
Ix in yak' aj t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, icha yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Ix in smakchej b'aj manhxa b'aj syal weli. Yet' wal k'e'en niwak cadena ix in stzek'a'.
Wach'chom tz'el waw in k'anan skolwal, max scha yab' tas tzin k'an t'ay.
Ix smak in b'e yet' k'e'en k'e'en, yuj chi' haxonhej t'a k'ex b'e tzin b'ati.
Lajan ix yutej sb'a Jehová t'ayin icha junok nok' oso sk'ub'ejel sb'a, icha junok nok' choj tz'elta juknaj t'ayin.
Ix in snherel t'a yol b'e yik chok' tzin yutejkanb'ati, ix in aktajkan yuj.
Ix sb'o'okh sjul-lab', ix kan ijan t'ayin yet' sjul-lab' chi'.
Ha sjul-lab' ix sjulkot t'ayin, ix k'axpaj t'a yol in k'o'ol.
Masanil heb' wetanimail sb'uchwaj t'ayin, a inxonhej tzin yal heb' t'a skal slolonel.
T'a wal sya'elal ix in ajek' yuj Dios. Te k'a' tas ix yak' wuk'ej.
Ix el weknaj k'e'en we ayik ix in em latnaj t'a sat lum yuj, ix in kan telan t'a kal pokok.
Manhxalaj in junk'olal, manhxo na'anok tzalajk'olal wu'uj.
Swalani to manhxa in tek'anil, yujto manhxo ayokoch Jehová yipok in k'o'ol.
Ha tzin na'ankot in kuselal yet' wek' in ch'okojil, te ya swab'i.
Ha wal yik tzin na'ankot juntzanh chi', manhxo animaok tzin aj swab'i.
Palta ay jun tas tzin nib'ej, aynhejek' t'a in pensar, haton jun chi' in gana swak'nhejoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Haton wal yuj swach'k'olal Jehová max onh sateli, yujto tz'ok'nhej sk'o'ol t'ayonh.
Junjun k'inhib'alil scheklaj swach'k'olal Jehová, syalnhej kak'anoch t'a ko k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' swala' to icha in makb'en yaj Jehová, anhej ayoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová t'a sk'o'ol, te wach' Jehová chi' t'a heb', haton heb' to sb'ek wal och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab'.
Te wach' tato numan tzonh aj ko tanhwani masanto skolwaj Jehová t'ayonh.
Yelxo wach' tato ayik unin animaonhto skak'anoch ko b'a t'a yalanh smandar Dios.
Wach' tato numan tzonh aj ko ch'okoj yakb'an syak'och ko ya'elal Jehová.
Yowalil tzonh och ejmelal, tzonh em nhojan t'a sat lu'um, talaj tz'ok' sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh.
Wach'chom tzonh mak'ji, tzonh b'uchji, palta ko chaokab'i.
Max onh yaktejkan Jehová t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom syak'och ko ya'elal, palta tz'ok'pax sk'o'ol t'ayonh, yujto te niwan swach'k'olal.
Wal yel malaj snib'ej syak'och ko kusk'olal yet' ko ya'elal.
Ha Jehová Dios Haxonhej Ochi, malaj snib'ej tz'ixtaj heb' anima t'a preso,
malaj pax snib'ej tz'ik'jiel sderecho heb' ak'b'il yuj.
Manh wach'ok t'a sat Dios tato max ch'olb'itaj heb' anima t'a stojolal.
Max elk'ochlaj tas sko na' tato manhok Jehová tz'alani.
Max jawilaj wach'ilal ma ya'elal, tato manhok Dios Haxonhej Och tz'alani.
¿Tas yuj chuk skab'i tato yuj ko chukal syak' ko ya'elal Dios?
Ko b'eyk'olejek wal ko b'a sik'lab'il, chajtil yilji ko b'eyb'al, skak'anxioch ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová.
Kak'ekb'at ko pensar t'a Dios aj satcha'anh, skalan t'a ko lesal icha tik:
Ix och ko mul, ix ko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, maj onh ak' niwank'olal.
Ix jawi yowal a k'ol t'ayonh, ix onh a pechani, ix onh a sateli, majxo ok'laj a k'o'ol t'ayonh.
Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'a, najat ach b'atkan t'ayonh yik maxtzak ab' ko lesal.
Icha k'alem ix onh utej t'a skal masanil anima.
Masanil heb' kajk'o'ol, ix onh sb'uchwal heb'.
Tzonh te xiwi yujto a heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh tzonh syam heb', tzonh yixtan heb', tzonh satanel heb', xko chi.
Tz'el wal jiljon yal in sat wok' yuj kusk'olal, yujto wan satel heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol waktej wok' yuj wab'annhej sya'il
masanto ol yak'kot swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayonh t'a satcha'anh.
Te yaxo pax swab' yet' in pixan yuj tas tzek' t'a yib'anh heb' ix ix t'a yol in chonhab'.
Ha heb' ajk'o'ol, tzin spech heb' wach'chom malaj jab'ok in mul. Icha tz'aj spechji junok nok' much icha chi' tzin yutej heb'.
Pitzan in wal ix in syumanem heb' t'a yol jun jul, ix smakankan sti' jun jul chi' heb' yet' jun k'e'en k'e'en, manhxa b'aj syal weli.
Ichato ay in em t'a yol ha ha', ix in na'ani to yikxo chamel waji.
Mamin Jehová, hato t'a sjulal yich jun jul tik tzin awaj t'ayach.
Ab' yoch in jaj, manh aktej ab'an in tewi.
Ix a nitzkot a b'a t'ayin ayik ix ach wawtani, ix halan t'ayin: Manh ach xiwok, xa chi.
Mamin, ix in a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak tas tzin utaj t'a manh stojolalok tik. B'o yaj t'ayin t'a stojolal.
Ojtak tas snib'ej heb' ajk'ol t'ayin yet' tas sna heb' tzin yutej.
Mamin Jehová, ix ab' jantak chukal syal heb' t'a in patik yet' jantak tas sna heb' tzin yutej.
Jun k'u syak' heb' in yalub'tanhani, sna'an heb' tas ol in yutok.
Ilnab' wal, k'ual t'ak'wal in sb'uchan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ak' spak t'a heb' icha wal smojalil yuj tas tzin yutej.
Ak' pitb'okel spensar heb', tzak'anb'at katab' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Mamin, pech heb' yet' yowal a k'o'ol. Satel heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
